article.title: Google could soon make it easier to listen to your Gemini Daily Brief
article.summary: TL;DR Google is working on a new button in Gemini Daily Brief that will read the briefing aloud. It could make it easier for users to listen to their briefings without having to ask Gemini Live to read them. Google has been working on several new features and improvements for the Gemini Daily Brief. We’ve seen the company working on making the Daily Brief easier to customize and even adding it to the At a Glance widget on Pixel phones. Now, it seems the company is also working on making it easier to listen to your briefings. You’re reading an Authority Insights story. article.title: AIR raises $50M to help companies vet the skills and add-ons AI agents use
article.summary: AIR's platform can discover agents running at a company, continuously vets any skills and add-ons they use, and blocks any unwanted behavior.

article.title: 資安新創Corma種子輪募資6,000萬美元，開發資安防禦AI模型
article.summary: 主打資安防禦AI模型的新創公司Corma宣布完成6,000萬美元種子輪募資，本輪由紅杉資本（Sequoia Capital）領投，Khosla Ventures與Coatue參與投資。Corma也同步結束隱身階段，公開旗下首款AI基礎模型，讓AI代理與資安團隊共同處理企業環境中的威脅偵測與防禦工作。
